item.title: Conference “Gender discrimination in Modern Greece”. Norwegian Institute, Athens - June 26, 2023
item.description: Call for proposals - deadline April 1, 2023/deadline extended to April 15, 2023 Note: Submission deadline is extended to April 15, 2023 Recent research not only argues that female infanticide and the mortal neglect of female infants was more common in Modern Greece than previously acknowledged, but also that Greek parents continued to treat boys and girls differently throughout childhood (in terms of food and care).
